evidence.eyes_blue: The exposed profile eye reads as a dark, reddish slit; a pale ice-blue iris is not visibly established.
evidence.head_level: The profile nose and chin project horizontally left, with no downward bow of the face.
evidence.head_aligned: The head, chest and pointed boots all turn left without a sideways head tilt.
evidence.no_skull_buckle: The foreshortened belt disc contains a branching ornament rather than a skull.
evidence.no_skull_shoulder: The near pauldron has one horn and decorative metalwork, without a skull face.
evidence.no_skull_book: The exposed leather book cover has corner fittings and no visible skull.
evidence.ribcage_steel: The raised chest ribs have sharp reflective metal highlights over a dark cuirass, despite the pink color cast.
evidence.tome_master_ornament: The near-hip tome has a plain dark cover, silver-colored corner caps and a short red ribbon below it.
evidence.hands_exactly_two: One gauntlet grips the raised shaft at screen-left and one grips it beside the near hip; no additional hand is visible.
evidence.hands_in_front: Null: this is a profile with the chest visible, not a back view.
evidence.blade_forward: The crescent extends and hooks toward screen-left, the direction of the face and toes.
evidence.haft_diagonal: The shaft runs strongly diagonally from the low hip grip to the extended shoulder-height grip.
evidence.scythe_held_out: The upper arm reaches leftward and a clear green gap separates the upper shaft from the face and chest.
evidence.buckle_detail: The round disc is seen obliquely but its silver border and small branching sigil remain drawn and legible.
evidence.standing_upright: The torso is vertical and the straight legs support a narrow, stationary stance.
evidence.camera_matches: The long side-on boots and predominantly side-view head and shoulders read substantially shallower than Image 2's downward view.
evidence.scale_matches: Visual sole-to-crown extent is approximately 865 of 1254 pixels, essentially the same as Image 2's approximately 865 pixels.
evidence.mirrored: The horn is on the near shoulder and the tome is on the near hip, correctly showing his left side for W.
evidence.seen_facing: Nose, chest projection and both sabaton toes point screen-left.

reasons.1: Dark contours are present, but smooth volumetric highlights and busy surface modeling dominate over the required clean painted animation planes.
reasons.2: Two checklist falses: eyes_blue and camera_matches; the principal costume identifiers otherwise remain visible.
reasons.3: Upper-left-facing hair and armor receive the strongest light, but pink highlights and warm brown ambient replace the required cold key and cool shadows.
reasons.4: Three equipment errors against the W expectation: blade assembly is ahead at screen-left instead of behind the far shoulder at screen-right, crescent is broadside rather than edge-on, and its cutting tip is below the attachment rather than highest; sides are correct.
reasons.5: At a qualitative 64-pixel silhouette read, the strongly leftward face and both pointed boots make W unambiguous.

candidates.seen_facing: W; left-facing profile with reversed shoulder asymmetry

evidence.eyes_blue: A small pale blue iris is visible beneath the dark brow in the left-facing eye.
evidence.head_level: The chin is held level and the visible eye looks horizontally left rather than toward the ground.
evidence.head_aligned: Head, torso and boots share the left-facing orientation without a lateral head tilt.
evidence.no_skull_buckle: The round belt disc carries a simple branching sigil, with no skull features.
evidence.no_skull_shoulder: The broad near pauldron has abstract ornament and no skull; the single horn is visible behind the head.
evidence.no_skull_book: No skull-bearing book is visible; the tome itself is hidden, so its unseen cover cannot be verified.
evidence.ribcage_steel: The raised ribs read as reflective metal strips over dark armor rather than exposed ivory bones.
evidence.tome_master_ornament: Null: no identifiable exposed tome cover, corner caps and ribbon can be inspected at the hip.
evidence.hands_exactly_two: There are exactly two visible gauntlets gripping the shaft, one high in front and one low by the belt and hip.
evidence.hands_in_front: Null: this is a chest-visible profile rather than a back view.
evidence.blade_forward: The crescent hooks screen-left, agreeing with the face direction despite the incorrect shoulder asymmetry.
evidence.haft_diagonal: The long shaft rises steeply like a standard, with the upper grip stacked above the low grip instead of the broad held-out diagonal of the reference.
evidence.scythe_held_out: The upper hand reaches forward at about shoulder height and holds the upper shaft clear of the chest; this remains visible despite the overly steep shaft angle.
evidence.buckle_detail: The silver-rimmed round disc has a distinct small leaf-like branching center.
evidence.standing_upright: The spine and legs are upright, with closely placed feet and no crouch or combat spread.
evidence.camera_matches: Some crown is visible, but the long side-view lower legs and boot profiles do not match Image 2's stronger elevated foreshortening.
evidence.scale_matches: Visual sole-to-crown extent is approximately 810 pixels versus approximately 865 in Image 2, about 6 percent smaller and within tolerance.
evidence.mirrored: The large near shoulder is unhorned while the horn emerges behind the hair on the far shoulder; this reverses the required near-left horn for W, and the expected near-hip tome is absent from view.
evidence.seen_facing: The nose, visible chest and both boot tips point screen-left.

reasons.1: The contour and larger armor planes are readable, but smooth specular modeling and mottled fills still look more like a finished illustration than an animation frame.
reasons.2: Two checklist falses: haft_diagonal and camera_matches; the separate mirrored flag records the reversed anatomy, while the hidden tome is not counted as false.
reasons.3: Hair and forward-facing upper edges suggest an upper-left key, but the pervasive rose-metal and brown shadow cast violates the cold-light register.
reasons.4: Mirrored = 1: the horn is on the far shoulder instead of the near left shoulder; the blade also sits screen-left rather than behind the far shoulder at screen-right.
reasons.5: At a qualitative 64-pixel silhouette read, the left-facing profile and aligned leftward boots clearly communicate W independently of the equipment reversal.

candidates.seen_facing: NW; back three-quarter view toward upper-left

evidence.eyes_blue: Null: the back of the head and only a narrow cheek edge are shown; neither iris is visible.
evidence.head_level: The skull sits upright above the neck and the long hair descends down the back without a visible forward head bow.
evidence.head_aligned: The small left cheek edge agrees with the body's back-left turn, with no opposing head twist or sideways tilt.
evidence.no_skull_buckle: No skull is visible on the exposed rear belt; the front buckle is occluded and cannot be inspected.
evidence.no_skull_shoulder: The screen-left horn and both decorated pauldrons show abstract metalwork rather than a skull face.
evidence.no_skull_book: The book's faint cover ornament is abstract scrolling or branching relief, without recognizable skull features.
evidence.ribcage_steel: Null: the back of the cuirass is shown and the chest ribs are occluded.
evidence.tome_master_ornament: The screen-left book has corner fittings and a red ribbon, but its warm brown cover also carries a large faint embossed scrolling motif instead of the master's plain cover.
evidence.hands_exactly_two: Two gauntlets terminate the visible arms at the raised screen-right shaft and lower screen-left grip; no third or floating hand appears.
evidence.hands_in_front: The raised right gauntlet and folded forearm are fully exposed beside the rear shoulder, and the lower arm and grip are exposed behind the near hip, rather than hands concealed in front with only an edge showing.
evidence.blade_forward: The crescent sweeps leftward from its screen-right mounting, in the screen-left component of the NW facing.
evidence.haft_diagonal: The exposed high-right and low-left shaft sections establish a diagonal through the occluded torso region.
evidence.scythe_held_out: The raised grip is pulled beside the shoulder on a bent arm; the visible arm arrangement does not establish the forward, extended shoulder-height hold of the master.
evidence.buckle_detail: Null: the front belt disc is hidden by the back-view torso.
evidence.standing_upright: The feet are staggered and the screen-right leg is flexed and lifted relative to the straighter support leg, reading as a step rather than the prescribed straight-legged standing rest.
evidence.camera_matches: The crown, broad upper shoulder surfaces and upper boot surfaces are visible from above, with shortened feet consistent with the elevated reference.
evidence.scale_matches: Visual sole-to-crown extent is approximately 725 pixels versus approximately 865 in Image 2, about 16 percent smaller and outside tolerance.
evidence.mirrored: The horn and tome both occupy screen-left on the exposed left side of the back view, as required for NW.
evidence.seen_facing: The back dominates, a slim cheek edge appears on the left, and the nearer left side supports an upper-left rather than upper-right facing.

reasons.1: Dense armor ornament, glossy pink modeling and finely streaked hair overwhelm the restrained planar animation register despite a readable outer contour.
reasons.2: Five checklist falses: tome_master_ornament, hands_in_front, scythe_held_out, standing_upright and scale_matches; hidden eyes, ribs and buckle are excluded.
reasons.3: Upper-left-facing hair and horn catch light, but rose highlights and warm brown recesses do not maintain the required cold key and cool ambient.
reasons.4: Two equipment-error groups: the conspicuously exposed folded arms and grips do not follow the hidden-in-front arrangement, and the tome adds cover ornament; horn/tome sides and the high-right blade/low-left butt layout are correct.
reasons.5: At a qualitative 64-pixel silhouette read, the back and left-side horn suggest NW, but the nearly rear-facing head and staggered feet make the diagonal less decisive than the W profiles.

candidates.seen_facing: SE; front three-quarter view toward screen-right

evidence.eyes_blue: Both visible irises have pale icy blue highlights beneath the dark brows.
evidence.head_level: The chin is fractionally raised and the eyes look outward on the horizon, with no downward face bow.
evidence.head_aligned: The face and cuirass turn together toward screen-right, and the head has no lateral tilt or backward counter-turn.
evidence.no_skull_buckle: The round buckle contains a clear upright branching leaf-like sigil rather than a skull.
evidence.no_skull_shoulder: The near shoulder has layered plates and the far shoulder has one horn; neither carries a skull face.
evidence.no_skull_book: The partially exposed far-hip leather tome shows no skull on its visible surfaces.
evidence.ribcage_steel: The rib relief has continuous bright reflective edges over black armor and reads as polished metal, although tinted pink.
evidence.tome_master_ornament: Visible portions of the far-hip tome show leather, silver-colored corner fittings and a short red ribbon without an additional emblem; the forearm hides much of the cover.
evidence.hands_exactly_two: Exactly two gauntlets visibly wrap the shaft, one extended at screen-left and the other low at screen-right.
evidence.hands_in_front: Null: this is a front three-quarter view, not a back view.
evidence.blade_forward: The crescent curves and points screen-right, matching the character's facing.
evidence.haft_diagonal: The shaft crosses diagonally from the far-left-hip grip at screen-right to the raised near-right-hand grip at screen-left.
evidence.scythe_held_out: The near arm extends outward at shoulder height, with a substantial gap between the raised shaft and the chest.
evidence.buckle_detail: A crisp round silver rim encloses a clearly drawn branching central sigil.
evidence.standing_upright: The torso is upright, the legs are nearly straight and the feet remain close beneath the hips without a fighting spread.
evidence.camera_matches: The face and tall upper torso read from a shallower elevation, with less crown exposure and less downward compression than Image 2's scene-camera figure.
evidence.scale_matches: Visual sole-to-crown extent is approximately 940 pixels versus approximately 865 in Image 2, about 9 percent larger and just within tolerance.
evidence.mirrored: The unhorned right shoulder is near at screen-left; the horn and partially occluded tome occupy the far left side at screen-right, as required for SE.
evidence.seen_facing: The visible face, chest and boot directions form a front three-quarter turn toward the viewer's lower-right.

reasons.1: The outer drawing is clear, but smoothly modeled metallic bands, dense mottling and fine hair highlights exceed the clean, restrained painted-plane register.
reasons.2: One checklist false: camera_matches; the visible eyes, sigil, asymmetrical equipment and two-handed held-out rest retain the main identity cues.
reasons.3: The upper-left shoulder and hair carry the main highlights, but the pink steel and warm brown shadows conflict with the fixed cold lighting palette.
reasons.4: Two blade errors against the SE expectation: its cutting tip is lower than the upper blade arc rather than the highest point, and the crescent reaches inward over the head instead of hooking outward away from it; hand arrangement and anatomical equipment sides are correct.
reasons.5: At a qualitative 64-pixel silhouette read, the chest and head clearly turn right in a frontal three-quarter view, though the shallow camera makes the lower-right component less strong.
